name: Agentic AI Developer

fee.note: Microsoft prices GitHub exams by exam country/region; the exam page shows the price for your location, before taxes. US price USD 165; USD 99 in Argentina, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru and most of Latin America; EUR 126 in Spain (Microsoft's price list, 2026-11-17).

exam.format: Proctored 120-minute exam through Pearson VUE, online or at a test center; interactive components may appear. Microsoft does not publish the question count or question types per exam.

access.retake: After a failed attempt you wait 24 hours to retake, then 14 days between later attempts, with at most five attempts in 12 months; each retake is paid.
access.accommodations: The exam is only in English, so non-native speakers can request 30 extra minutes (English as a second language) before scheduling; other accommodations are requested through Pearson VUE.

scope: Agent architecture, tool use, memory/state, evaluation, multi-agent coordination and accountability inside production SDLC workflows.
ai_policy: Check the current exam resource policy. A coding-agent certification does not itself permit AI during the assessment.
caveats: Microsoft says most of its exams have 40–60 questions but does not publish the count for GH-600.

The GH-600 page gives no validity period. The other GitHub certification pages on Microsoft Learn say GitHub certifications are valid for 2 years while GitHub moves to Microsoft's renewal process; the GH-600 study guide only carries Microsoft's general note that associate certifications expire every year and renew free online.
